gotchas.fix: Install and wire a StyleX compiler (@stylexjs/unplugin or your bundler's integration) — without it no Astryx styles are compiled. Run `astryx doctor` to verify.
gotchas.title: StyleX compiler not wired
gotchas.trigger: App renders unstyled; stylex.create() styles never apply

gotchas.fix: In your app entry import, in order: @astryxdesign/core/reset.css, then astryx.css, then the theme CSS.
gotchas.title: Base stylesheets missing or misordered

gotchas.fix: Declare the @layer order explicitly — unlayered styles and later layers always beat astryx-base. See `astryx docs migration` (Cascade Layer Safety).
gotchas.title: Cascade layers unordered
gotchas.trigger: Astryx styles silently lose to project CSS

gotchas.fix: Use the SWC-based StyleX transform — never the Babel plugin.
gotchas.title: Babel StyleX plugin on Next.js
gotchas.trigger: next/font breaks or StyleX fails to compile on Next.js App Router

gotchas.fix: Run `astryx theme build` for custom themes (emits CSS + JS + types); use the /built subpaths for bundled themes. Runtime-applied themes flash on hydration.
gotchas.title: Theme flashes on hydration (SSR)
gotchas.trigger: Wrong theme or unstyled flash on first paint in SSR/production

gotchas.fix: No <div>/<span> for layout — components own layout and spacing; read `astryx docs layout` before writing pages.
gotchas.title: Raw div/span layout
gotchas.trigger: Layout or spacing looks off compared to the design

gotchas.fix: Use tokens for every value (`astryx docs tokens`); brand/accent belongs in the theme (`astryx theme add <slug>`) — never override --color-* in :root.
gotchas.title: Hardcoded colors instead of tokens
gotchas.trigger: Custom colors don't retint with the theme

gotchas.title: :hover without touch guard
gotchas.trigger: :hover styles never apply, or stick on touch devices

gotchas.fix: Invoke via `npx @astryxdesign/cli`, or add the astryx script to package.json.
gotchas.title: Bare npx invocation hits the wrong package
gotchas.trigger: `npx astryx` resolves to an unrelated package

gotchas.fix: Pin exact versions; run `astryx upgrade --apply` after any bump (refreshes the agent block and codemods).
gotchas.title: Breakage after dependency bump
gotchas.trigger: Build breaks after bumping Astryx packages

gotchas.fix: Use light-dark() only inside theme files; components consume tokens.
gotchas.title: light-dark() outside theme files
gotchas.trigger: light-dark() colors ignore the active theme

gotchas.fix: Use logical properties (margin-inline-start), not physical ones (margin-left).
gotchas.title: Physical CSS properties
